main_text.p: Altare suffitus, erat altare vnius cubiti longitudine, & latitudine, duorum vero altitudine, auro lecto, structurae lateribus, vectibus, & circumquaq;, obductum, vt sit thymiaterium suffitus. Exo. 30. 1. 2. 3. 6.
main_text.l: Habet Annulos duos aureos in limbu iuxta
partes binos angulos aptatos, ad duo late-
proprias tera eius, quod erat in sedis vecti-
main_text.p: Posi um autem erant ante velum, quod erat ante arcam testimonij, quo Deus conuenturus erat cum Moyse, semelq; quotannis in cornibus eius expiationem ex sanguine sacrificij oblati, facturi erant cū animos affligerent.

Significabat autem, Christum omni potestate ornatum a patre in coelo coram Deo regnare, ut pro nobis appareat & gratum cultum nostrum in se faciat, ex virtute sacrificij pro peccato semel sacti, ut ita intercessio, altera muneris pars adumbraretur. Heb. 9. 24. 25. 26. 27. 28. &c. & 10. 14. cum Apoc. 8 3. inter se comparatis.
Alia instrumenta ⸢ Praeciosa magis. tabernacula sunt ⸣ Minus praeciosum.
Praeciosa magis, quorum materia & vsus erat excellentior. Ex sequent.

page.notes: The brace diagram at the left is a bracket with "Habet partes proprias" as its label; the right-hand boxes are rendered as lines above. Some words in the diagram are partly obscured. Right edge strip is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Right margin strip is cut and mostly illegible; the scan is cropped at the right. Marginal words such as "Limb", "cillar", "Qua", "habet" are only partly visible and are not transcribed. Several words in the central text are faint and uncertain.
